scientific_integrity: The proof uses the published complete quasisolution-chain classification, exact recurrence identities, a congruence argument limiting common primes to 3 and 7, direct exclusions of common 9 and 49, and complete short modular periods modulo 3 and 7. Finite replay is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the common divisor of the two cyclotomic values in a sigma_2,2 pair. It does not prove either value individually squarefree and therefore does not settle the source's squarefreeness conjecture.
title: Exact common cyclotomic divisor for \(\sigma_{2,2}\) prime pairs
